links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot answers to patient maxillofacial prosthodontics questions versus health literacy guidelines
links.effect: FKGL differed significantly among chatbots (P=.002); DeepSeek had the lowest FKGL (best readability) and ChatGPT the highest; none consistently met health literacy guidelines.
links.quote: Although the DeepSeek and ChatGPT platforms produced higher-quality content, none consistently met health literacy guidelines.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four commercial LLM chatbots answering frequently asked questions in maxillofacial prosthodontics using readability metrics and expert ratings, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
